capabilities: Highlight words repeated within a set word, sentence, or paragraph distance
Configure language rules, minimum length, plurals, accents, and ignored words
Choose highlight style or wavy underline
Toggle highlighting via a hotkey command
extras: Does not work in Reading view; manual installation instructions are included; the manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian gives no feedback on unintended word repetition while writing, which makes prose editing harder.
summary: Writing aid that highlights words repeated too close together while you type, in English and Spanish, with configurable scope and rules.
